ImageDescription.value: Yet another ancient Chinese temple in Hanoi's old quarter. I did not go in of course, but the posters displayed under the thatched place holders up front seemed to suggest that this temple is in some way involved in water puppetry, maybe a training school for working the puppets or a centre for producing masks and puppets. I was amazed at the large number of Chinese style temples in Hanoi, despite the slight anti-Chinese sentiment in the country, which was of course more pronounced in the South. (Hanoi, Vietnam, Oct./ Nov. 2016)
